final: WITH c AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_all FROM c), h AS (SELECT c.account_id, c.cnt FROM c, a WHERE c.cnt > a.avg_all), b AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_high FROM h) SELECT h.account_id, h.cnt AS order_count, h.cnt - a.avg_all AS diff_from_avg, h.cnt - b.avg_high AS diff_from_high_avg FROM h, a, b ORDER BY diff_from_high_avg DESC LIMIT 10
